🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a secure, efficient, and visually personalized Neovim environment optimized for developers who use AI assistants for code generation and require a robust code review and editing workflow.
✨ Key Features: • Offline language servers (LSP) for security • Wallpaper-based color theming (pywal) • Russian language interface and keybindings • AI-assisted code editing workflow focus • Minimal plugin count, security-audited code
📖 Summary: This Neovim configuration, built from scratch for version 0.12, focuses on security and a streamlined coding experience. It integrates with the user's wallpaper for color themes, runs language servers offline, and provides a Russian-language interface, specifically tailored for AI-assisted code review and editing.
